order_prng: Python random.Random(20261030), shuffle wait/reject/retry/drop independently per block
replacement: A transient operational invalid run excludes its whole partial block; retry that complete block once, same order/seed. Do not finish remaining policies in invalid attempt. Stop on repeat invalidity, any safety/invariant/source failure, or same transient category twice. Never replace valid unfavorable outcomes.

primary_analysis.endpoint: U/N, U=unique authoritative completion offset<=original deadline; N=2880 including unsent
primary_analysis.estimate: arithmetic mean of paired within-block differences; retain all five per-block differences and medians
primary_analysis.uncertainty: exact paired block bootstrap all n^n=3125 ordered size5 resamples; linear-interpolated2.5/97.5 percentiles; descriptive only, no p-values/significance/equivalence claim
primary_analysis.completion_latency: scheduled->authoritative terminal completion, only completed cohort; all completed and on-time-only n,p50,p95,p99 per-run; no pooled headline
primary_analysis.secondary: all-original partitions; A/N and retries/N; admission wait admitted cohort; queue residence started cohort; occupied worker ns by disposition; sampled RSS and /proc CPU; gRPC/TCP bytes; server owned payload byte-time integral[0,39]; queue max; send duration; all-original deadline attainment; recovery

recovery.clearance: first time no pre24s admitted queued/running originals remain; zero if empty at24; censored if any unresolved by39. Do not impute censored values as recovery.
recovery.series: one-second unique on-time completion counts and client pending+outstanding/server occupied originals for[24,39]
recovery.steady_state: no claim from short recovery window

hypothesis_assessment.H1: supported if all5 WAIT runs show slowdown capacity constraint (completed-only service median>=40ms), occupied32, nonzero upstream pending and backlog/expiry. Mixed otherwise; no measured pressure despite constraint is contrary evidence.
hypothesis_assessment.H2: descriptive support if mean paired REJECT-WAIT server payload-byte-time integral<0 and at least4/5 negative, with refusal present in all REJECT; otherwise mixed/not established. Report unique admitted fractions and peak occupancy too.
hypothesis_assessment.H3: descriptive support only if mean paired RETRY-REJECT U/N>0, bootstrap lower>0, at least4/5 positive and retry-converted on-time completions in at least4 blocks. Zero conversions is contrary to conversion benefit; do not infer benefit from aggregate noise alone.
hypothesis_assessment.H4: outcome-label distinction alone insufficient. Assess DROP-REJECT U/N/retention/conditional timing. No consistent paired direction(>=4/5) and intervals crossing0 means no distinct performance tradeoff established, not proof of equivalence.
hypothesis_assessment.H5: report recovery clearance/censoring and per-second rates; descriptive differentiation if at least one uncensored pair has interval excluding0 and>=4/5 consistent direction. Censoring/mixed evidence remains inconclusive.
hypothesis_assessment.no_claim: no universal winner, no causal attribution beyond this in-memory/debug/single-host model; conditional cohorts differ and all-original fractions govern headline
